name: nat-vent-comfort-floor-exit-restores-heat
description: Natural ventilation (fan_mode hvac_fan) stops when indoor drops to the comfort_heat floor on a cool day (Issue #99): the comfort-floor exit fires, so the house is not ventilated below comfort. The scenario checks the exit only; it does not assert a heat restore.

verdict.summary: When _natural_vent_active=True and indoor drops to comfort_heat, the comfort-floor exit fires (nat-vent ends)
verdict.observed_behavior: nat_vent_comfort_floor_exit when indoor reaches comfort_heat on a cool day
verdict.expected_behavior: nat_vent_comfort_floor_exit when indoor reaches comfort_heat; the scenario does not check a heat restore

events.note: Morning classification — cool day (high 60F, low 42F), hvac_mode heat, comfort_heat=70F
Indoor above floor, outdoor 56F well below threshold 78F — nat vent eligible
Door opens — enters natural ventilation, fan activates, HVAC off
Indoor dropped to comfort_heat=70F. Outdoor still cool — no outdoor exit. Comfort-floor exit must fire.

assertions.reason: door opened; outdoor 56F <= threshold 78F — nat vent activated
indoor 70F <= comfort_heat 70F — comfort-floor exit fires and the fan stops
